question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_products_sold,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        AVG(orv.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
packing_times AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600.0
        ) as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        p.product_category_name,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_total_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, p.product_category_name
),
top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name,
        category_total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_total_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_products_sold,
    ROUND(sm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sm.avg_review_score, 4) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(pt.avg_packing_hours, 4) as avg_packing_hours,
    tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN packing_times pt ON sm.seller_id = pt.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_category tcat ON sm.seller_id = tcat.seller_id AND tcat.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation tc ON tcat.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
